register_quantized_ops: register quantized ops for the PyTorch Inductor lowering infrastructure
add_needs_realized_inputs: add quantized.max_pool2d as an op that needs realized inputs in the lowering pass
make_fallback: configure quantized.max_pool2d to fall back to a non-compiled implementation in Inductor
lowering_add_needs_realized_inputs: add a list of quantized ops to the realized inputs requirement in the lowering module
lowering_make_fallback: mark a quantized op as a fallback target in the Inductor lowering pipeline
